description: This file defines the SystemConfiguration class which handles retrieving and setting system-related configuration data in the OrangeHRM system, including organization info, admin user details, and system instance identifiers.

classes.name: SystemConfiguration
classes.description: A utility class for managing and retrieving system configuration details within the OrangeHRM platform.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns a Doctrine DBAL Connection object for database interactions.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Returns the schema manager for the current database connection.

methods.name: getOrganizationName
methods.description: Retrieves the organization name from the database, or returns 'Not Captured' if unavailable.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Retrieves the organization country from the database, or returns 'Not Captured' if unavailable.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Fetches the default language setting, defaulting to 'en_US' if not set.

methods.name: getAdminFirstName
methods.description: Retrieves the first name of the admin user based on their employee number.

methods.name: getAdminLastName
methods.description: Retrieves the last name of the admin user based on their employee number.

methods.name: getAdminEmail
methods.description: Retrieves the email of the admin user.

methods.name: getAdminContactNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the admin's contact phone number.

methods.name: getAdminUserName
methods.description: Retrieves the username of the admin user.

methods.name: getInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the unique system instance identifier from configuration.

methods.name: getAdminEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Internal method to fetch the admin user's employee number from the database.

methods.name: setInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Sets a new system instance identifier based on provided system info.

methods.name: createInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Generates a base64-encoded string as a unique system instance identifier.

methods.name: isRegistrationEventQueueAvailable
methods.description: Checks whether the registration event queue table exists in the database.

methods.name: saveRegistrationEvent
methods.description: Stores a registration event in the event queue with timestamp, type, data, and publishing status.
